pre_adoption_reference_review:
# Q1/Q2 reference review and grouped Q1 timing

Reviewed frozen mx revision c4d12e2c0094c9028318bed5bb1a30bb48f8a35b against
llmx runtime ab7524ed1. Reference source remains separate from llmx.

## Source evidence

- mx ggml-vulkan.cpp:2883-2886,2945 selects four Q1 output rows on AMD GCN.
  mul_mat_vec.comp:45-93 loads activations outside the row loop, expands each
  row inside it, and performs float dots. dequant_funcs.glsl:130-144 expands
  Q1 bits to signs. This is a concrete activation-reuse pattern, not proof
  that four rows will improve llmx's different integer kernel.
- llmx matmul_row_two.glsl:17-34 holds expanded weights for both rows before
  loading shared activations. Its previous compiler report was 64 VGPR and
  four resident subgroups, versus 48 VGPR and five for one row, without spills.
  Register lifetime remains a hypothesis for further instruction-level review.
  Do not repeat the rejected streamed-pair experiment solely to reduce VGPR.
- llmx vulkan_matmul.hpp:278 excluded grouped projections from the existing
  two-row Q1 path. The isolated candidate removes only live.size()==1.
- mx vecdotq.cuh:678-771 uses packed int8 dots for Q1/Q2, byte permutations
  for unpacking, and per-32-element activation scales. Its Q2 HIP path has an
  AMD permutation specialization. These are not the same arithmetic policy
  as llmx block-int16 and must not be transplanted as a numerical no-op.
- mx ggml-vulkan.cpp:6580-6613 avoids quantized-activation single-column
  dispatch for AMD K<2048. Narrow-width activation conversion overhead is
  therefore a useful profiling target, not evidence of a Q2 decoder defect.

## Completed isolated speed screen

Boole-1.7B Q1_0, P128/G256, physical GPU8, four threads, ubatch512, F16 KV,
direct loading, same image and default clocks. Two blocks of
before/after/mx/mx/after/before. Four samples per arm, all twelve retained.

| Phase | Before tok/s | Grouped candidate tok/s | mx Vulkan target tok/s | Candidate vs before | Candidate vs mx |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| PP128 | 2484.36 | 2485.20 | 1121.28 | +0.03% | +121.64% |
| TG256 | 215.83 | 226.01 | 251.95 | +4.72% | -10.30% |

All raw file hashes and parsed rates verified. Monitor covers every call,
with no other-GPU, known unrelated-CPU or sampling-gap threshold flags.
Nine calls overlap disk flags. Process churn leaves unknown CPU deltas in
all calls. Aggregate disk counters cannot distinguish model loading from
unrelated traffic. These are reported limitations, not zero activity.

Profile confirms old one-row Q1 dispatch disappears. Total profiled decode
GPU time decreases from 648.856 to 617.955 ms. This supports the dispatch
explanation but does not establish every part of the remaining mx gap.
Focused CPU/Vulkan native checks passed before timing. No full-model output
identity check has yet been run for this grouped candidate. It is scratch,
not adopted, merged or published. Production is unchanged.

Next: check full-model output identity against the already qualified Q1
binary before adoption, reusing the independent HF results only if outputs
are bit-identical. Investigate instruction count and register lifetime for
the remaining decode gap. No correctness limits changed.
